label: Reviewed carrier and relation sense tags for the Fourth Way identification obligations, measured
summary: Follow-up to the #1832 pilot (PR #1843, attempts e63628f1 and e8bf6def, not merged at 87a1ca5f9; this attempt records the outcome there). Reviewed whole-binder sense tags for the carriers and relations that the pilot's identification obligations named, then measured the effect on the six Fourth Way targets 64498e7e, 4c79298d, 6c27657f, a9622441, eaa4c679, 101bdd62. DECISIONS. Each pair was decided by reading both declarations, their doc comments or module docstrings, the statement definition links and the sense definitions; the identifications made by instantiation in the verified arguments 8542e377, 4d1efe91 and c201b61a were used as evidence, not copied. (1) Being carriers, BEING_1 (being as entity, DISAMB-BEING): Entity of Aristotle's AsToBeingSoToTruthReading and CauseOfQualityInAnotherIsMoreSuchReading ('each thing'), Being of the quarta via, q.4 a.2, In Metaph. II (its module says its beings and respects are those of the quarta via readings), Stage-one and Stage-two declarations, B of GodMaximalCausal (3), PreexistenceWithoutTransfer (2), CausalMapsBatch1.CauseOfBeingHasWhatItGives and the shared CausalityFrame and GradesFrame. Each module reads its carrier as the beings of the one prima/quarta via vocabulary; none restricts it to bodies or to one series. (2) Respect carriers: no Respect sense existed. DEF-RESPECT (linked by about 160 records) could not itself become a sense without forcing a sense tag into each of their labels (truth check reported 157 label errors when tried), so a separate carrier-sense record RESPECT_1 (2b71ac5e, content DEF-RESPECT, after the frame-field pattern of 5cbd5a0a and eafd5d52) was created in a new disambiguation RESPECT (e795b5ae), with the contrasting RESPECT_2 (8c2658aa): a constructed finite model's respect type, after the schema-model sense of CASE_SIGNATURE_INTERPRETATION (#1823). Tagged RESPECT_1: the same declarations as (1) except SomethingOtherThanGodExists, which has no respect carrier. The tag fixes only the domain; it chooses no distinguished respect and decides nothing about which respects are perfections. (3) Relations. IN_ACT_4: Aristotle's Has (possession of a respect, mode open; DEF-ESSE reads InAct x esse as having being), InAct of ExceededPerfectionIsCausedReading, DistinctCauseHasWhatItGives and CauseOfBeingHasWhatItGives. MORE_1: MoreIn of ExceededPerfectionIsCausedReading, MoreInIsAsymmetric, CauseOfBeingIsMoreInBeing and both Aristotle readings (the primitive comparative, no order laws). CAUSE_2: CausesIn of ExceededPerfectionIsCausedReading, NoInfiniteRegressOfCausesOfAPerfectionReading, DistinctCauseHasWhatItGives, CauseOfBeingIsMoreInBeing, GodCausesBeingOfAllOthers, SimplyPriorIsCauseOfBeing and Aristotle's CauseOfQualityInAnotherIsMoreSuchReading (whose doc comment says CausesIn carries no synonymy condition, as DEF-CAUSE-OF-PERFECTION). Esse respect (WORLD_RELATIVE_EXISTENCE_METAPHYSICAL_ESSE_NECESSITY_5): esse of GodCausesBeingOfAllOthers, CauseOfBeingIsMoreInBeing, SimplyPriorIsCauseOfBeing, CauseOfBeingHasWhatItGives, and Aristotle's being, read as the respect in which a thing has being; the Thomistic thesis that esse is the actuality of all acts is not attributed to Metaphysics II.1 (it is the open premise ActualityOnlyInsofarAsBeingReading, outside the field). PRIOR_1: PriorSimply of SimplyPriorIsCauseOfBeing. GOD_4: IsGod of StageTwo.GodIsMaximalInBeing, GodCausesBeingOfAllOthers and SomethingOtherThanGodExists, whose statements link DEF-GOD-OF-CLASSICAL-THEISM. TRUE_3 (truth said of things, DEF-ONTOLOGICAL-TRUTH): verum of MostTrueIsMostBeingReading and GradesFoundInThingsReading and Aristotle's truth, whose doc comment fixes it as truth said of things; Aquinas cites the sentence for the step and statement 5a948c37 already links DEF-ONTOLOGICAL-TRUTH. REFUSED OR LEFT UNTAGGED, with reasons. (a) DEF-RESPECT as the sense itself: refused for the label reason above; a merge needs every linked record relabelled. (b) DEF-PHYSICAL-RESPECT or respects of change as a second RESPECT sense: refused; they are guarded subclasses of one carrier, and two arguments (ARIST-PHYS-VIII-4) link both DEF-RESPECT and DEF-PHYSICAL-RESPECT, so a sense split would misreport them as mixing. (c) Partial-application slices (CausesIn _ _ esse, CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_3) on the new declarations: not added; they identify nothing and were not on any obligation. (d) The frame-bound declarations (CartesianAdequacy.ContainmentInEveryCause and the GradesFrame adapters): their carriers are section variables of a frame binder F, not signature binders; left untagged, so the Cartesian route 400ba1f0 still uses a frame bundle. (e) Rest of the IN_ACT_4/MORE_1 cluster (about 25 further declarations) and other IsGod binders: not reviewed here, left unknown. (f) TRUE_3 on Aristotle's truth carries a recorded caveat: DEF-ONTOLOGICAL-TRUTH includes Aquinas's analysis of the truth of things as conformity to the intellect on which a thing depends (ST I q.16 a.1); the tag identifies the respect, not that analysis, which Metaphysics II.1 does not state. If a reviewer holds the analysis part of the sense, the tag and the existing definition link of 5a948c37 must be revisited together, for instance by splitting truth said of things from Aquinas's account. LEAN. GodMaximalCausal and PreexistenceWithoutTransfer declared B and R as section variables, which the offline tag reader does not count as signature binders; the five declarations now state {B R : Type} (or {B : Type}) in their own signatures. The elaborated constants are unchanged (binder export before the edit: B, R in the same order, R absent from SomethingOtherThanGodExists); lake build and bind-check of the 321 affected results pass. MEASURED at base 87a1ca5f9, Duper only, default 8 candidates, 100k heartbeats. Plain run, explicit targets, pool all (scripts/run-discovery.sh): before (report 20261122T162154Z-an7P3DcB) 6 unresolved, 0 proved; after (report 20261122T163553Z-UkBtUGdy) 6 unresolved, 0 proved, identical candidate lists for every goal; the tagged carriers now enter the goals with BEING_1/RESPECT_1 and by-name carrier identifications drop from 69 to 50 over the six goals. The plain run is unchanged because retrieval does not use the tags. Identification-only runs (the same command with --module restricted to the target and its known-route premise declarations plus ExcludedMiddle, so retrieval cannot hide the known premises; with the corpus tags stashed for before): before 5 of 5 unresolved; after 3 proved: 101bdd62 from 5a948c37, filtered known (8542e377) and senses (MAXIMAL_IN_A_SELECTED_PERFECTION_GREATEST_1 against _6, the existing definition-link inconsistency noted in attempt 9869069b); 64498e7e from f8ba2429, c11369aa and d5a94eb1, reported as a certified discovery (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound), which is the verified argument 6b609ddc without its explicit excluded-middle premise ee4ab504, so known modulo the classical logic that Duper supplies; eaa4c679 from 70e98bb5 and 18561596, reported as a discovery, which is the pilot's route c9bdd003 (PR #1843, not merged) again without the excluded-middle premise. Neither discovery is registered; both are conditional on OPEN premises and are known routes, not new philosophy. 4c79298d and 6c27657f stay unresolved even narrowed: retrieval eligibility admitted only 86d02b69, e4484bdc, cffad050 and only c11369aa, f29a6b53 respectively. RETRIEVAL MISSES (input for engine work). (i) Ranking uses parameter names, not tags: in the full pool 5a948c37 (101bdd62), 70e98bb5 (eaa4c679), d5a94eb1/c11369aa/d0fc96b7/634a80b8 (64498e7e), all five known premises of 4c79298d and all four of 6c27657f are outside the top 8, both before and after tagging. (ii) Eligibility (shared parameter name plus shared project vocabulary or definition) excludes, even from a narrowed pool, MoreInIsAsymmetric a4814f25 and MoreSuchHasThePerfectionReading c11369aa for 4c79298d, DistinctCauseHasWhatItGives 2c0b9bd7 and NoInfiniteRegressOfCausesOfAPerfectionReading 5cda1946 for 6c27657f: they mention no project constant and share no definition_ids with the target. A shared whole-binder sense would be the natural eligibility signal. (iii) ExcludedMiddle ee4ab504 is never a candidate, and the known filter does not match a proof that uses the classical axioms in place of an argument's explicit ee4ab504 premise, so known routes resurface as discoveries. No proof, closure or frontier change (frontier-diff against origin/main: no change).
blocker: Next tests: (1) engine: use whole-binder sense tags in retrieval eligibility and ranking, treat ee4ab504 as available logic in the known filter; then rerun the plain baseline, which should filter 101bdd62, 64498e7e and 4c79298d/6c27657f as known. (2) Review and tag the remaining IN_ACT_4/MORE_1 cluster declarations' carriers, and IsGod binders elsewhere, under the same reading test. (3) Reconcile the MAXIMAL_IN_A_SELECTED_PERFECTION_GREATEST_1 and _6 definition links of MostTrueIsMostBeingReading and 5a948c37. (4) Decide whether DEF-ONTOLOGICAL-TRUTH should separate truth said of things from Aquinas's conformity analysis.
